changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/11659-console-record-ux.md`

- names `HomePage.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **The backup-password reminder no longer appears in the user's first session.** 「建议设置一个备用密码」 showed on the environment home right after a new user built their first app: the reminder was gated on a home-visit count (quiet on the first home mount, shown on the second), and coming back to home after building is the second mount inside the first sitting. It now stays quiet for 12 hours after the first home visit on the device, so it first shows on a later day's visit. The first-visit record (`os:recovery-pw-first-seen`) now holds a timestamp; a device that holds the old `'1'` flag starts the 12 hours over rather than reading it as long ago. When storage is unavailable it stays quiet. `RecoveryPasswordReminder` moves out of `HomePage.tsx` into its own module; it is not exported from the package entry, and its other conditions (dismissed, SSO-enforced, has a local password) are unchanged.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `efa9cb4fa` (merge-base with origin/main): 26 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 577 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (597 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/38909600015)

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · objectui#12604 · head `94f4369` · 2026-10-16T13:42Z

Seat `domain:ui#4`, session `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`. Checked against GitHub and the diff, not against the report (relayed on the card). The seat opened this PR from the dev's drafts (degraded channel), and the body is the dev's verbatim.

**Checklist**
- **Form:**
  - Draft → `main`, assignee `os-sales`.
  - The first line is `Fixes #12604`, and the second is `Clause-②: yes`, as the amended claim `6213030073` declares.
  - The head `94f4369` merges `origin/main` `f78efdd`, which carries objectui#12602 (`db8ce2f`). `git merge-tree` against current `main` `efa9cb4` is clean. No PNG on the branch.
- **Diff, 27 files (+1,155 / −180):**
  - **One store.** `RecentItemsProvider` gains the `view` kind (`RecentViewItem`: `object` and `name`, both required, no display text). A view entry missing either is dropped on read. The cap rises from 8 to 20. Dedupe stays by target.
  - **Visit calls.** `RecordDetailView` already recorded the record, and is unchanged and pinned. `useTrackRouteAsRecent` (run by `AppContent` on every route) records a `/view/VIEW` route as its view. The object's own entry now comes only from the object's list and data routes, not from record, create or edit routes.
  - **Home.** `HomeContinue` draws up to six 40 px rows, newest first, each with the kind icon (a record takes its object's icon), the title and the trail "object · app · time". The time goes through `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` with the display locale. `HomeActivity` takes the artboard layout and keeps its `sys_activity` gate; without it the recent block spans the full width.
  - In the merge, #12602's My work section, drafts row and section order are kept exactly as `main` has them. `Card` and `Row` leave with the old cards that alone used them.
  - One new key per locale pack: `home.recentApps.itemType.view`.
- **Tests:**
  - Three new pin files plus four updated ones cover every evidence item of the order: record page records, list view records, home order + icon + trail, store cap 20 + dedupe, full width without `sys_activity`, sidebar still renders.
  - Ten ablations, each red, each restored.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` in full on `94f4369`: 1,453 files, 13,726 tests, exit 0.
  - type-check, the i18n and app-shell builds, eslint on changed files, the four i18n checks, changeset presence: all exit 0.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, minor, user-facing prose; it names the widened `RecentItemType`.
- **Contract faces:** `Clause-②: yes`. `RecentItemType` gains `view`, and the exported `RecentItem` / `RecentItemInput` unions gain the view arm. The `TIER_DEFAULT` review is its own comment.
- **Screenshots:** HotCRM, 1280 px, en and zh-CN, light and dark, plus the sidebar, on the never-merged `claude/issue-12604-evidence` (`8ac7ebd`). The seat read zh-CN light: 最近访问 lists ACC-000001 - Acme Corporation (客户 · HotCRM · 2分钟前), 高管总览 (仪表盘 · HotCRM · 2分钟前), 客户卡片 (列表视图 · HotCRM · 3分钟前) and ACC-000003 - Initech Solutions, beside 活动动态, under #12602's 我的工作. Sent to the maintainer at 2026-10-16T13:42Z.
- **CI:** not yet run at this record. Landing waits for green. Watch `Bundle Analysis`: the eager closure on PR objectui#12662 read 3,118.6 of 3,119.4 KB, and objectui#12653 (the 20% headroom) is not yet built.

**Rulings**
1. **The `view` member (B): accepted.** The ruling allowed one member when the `object` entry cannot carry a view honestly. It cannot: it is labelled and kinded "Object", and an optional view is the tolerant shape. `RecentViewItem` is not exported by name, which keeps to "one member and nothing else"; a consumer narrows on `type === 'view'`.
2. **The seat's mechanism assumption 2 was false: a good result.** Records were already recorded (`RecordDetailView`), and lists were already recorded by `useTrackRouteAsRecent`; `StudioRoute` was not the only caller. The real gaps (a named view collapsing into its object, and no trail or icon) are what this PR fixes.
3. **Record, create and edit routes no longer record the object: accepted.** Measured live by the dev: every record opened pushed "Accounts" into the list beside it. It follows the ruling "dedupe by target", and it is pinned, ablated and stated in the changeset.
4. **The objectui#11678 pin "list route and view route are one visit" is replaced: accepted.** The ruling makes a named view its own target. A revisit still writes nothing.
5. **File surface:** `useRecentItemLabel.ts` (so the sidebar labels the new kind), `appLastOpened.ts` (exports its existing app reader, no second parser), and the two existing home tests given the new prop. Each is minimal and in the region: accepted.
6. **Target 4 wording:** the empty line keeps `home.continueEmpty`, since the claim allows new keys only. Accepted; the artboard's wording is not worth a key retirement here.
7. **Out of scope:** the record title is HotCRM's `display_title` as served (`ACC-000001 - Acme Corporation`), which is data and not this card's. The activity row's English summary in zh-CN is the producer's stored text. Neither is filed this round: this seat's session cannot run the duplicate search (the search API is refused here), and both stay in the dev's report on the card for triage.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `94f4369e410bf3396263fd4fb010898f935fdb01`
Local-runs: none

Face: the `Clause-②: yes` declaration of the amended claim `6213030073` on objectui#12604. The PR's file list carries no `packages/spec/src/**` path and no governed path. Inputs read: the card, the claim, the diff at the head above, the changeset and the PR body. Nothing was built or run locally.

### ① Derived judgments
- **Published types:** `RecentItemType`, exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`, gains `'view'`. The exported `RecentItem` and `RecentItemInput` unions gain a view arm (`object`, `name`, both required). `RecentNamedItem`'s member set is unchanged, since its `Exclude` also removes the new member. That is an additive widening; nothing is removed or retyped. A consumer that switches exhaustively over the kinds must add a case, and the changeset says so. **Correct, and declared.**
- **Published keys:** `home.recentApps.itemType.view` joins every locale pack, so the `en` pack's exported `TranslationKeys` widens by one key. **Correct, and declared.**
- **Persisted shape:** stored entries keep their key and format. A stored `view` entry missing its object or name is dropped on read, and old entries still read as before. The cap rises to 20, and a longer stored list is capped on read. **Compatible.**
- **Behaviour:** a named list view is its own entry, and record, create and edit routes stop recording their object. No authored key, schema or accept set changes. **Correct.**

### ② Semver level
The changeset bumps `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` minor, in `pre` mode on tag `next`. Minor fits a widened union and one new key. **Consistent.**

### ③ Boundary flags
- None to the maintainer. The landing waits on CI, with `Bundle Analysis` watched against the eager-closure ceiling (objectui#12653 holds the 20% headroom).
